user_statement: ok i filled in the ratings, i think these are decent, maybe better than what we composed in terms of 'raw ambience'
scope: Single personal first pass on seven level-matched three-minute excerpts; identical comfort/keep-playing scores. Distraction fields blank, not zero. No long-session approval or causal significance inferred.

ratings.name: Spirewatch
ratings.notes: too fast really to be ambient

ratings.name: Rainline
ratings.notes: the rain adds something here i think, maybe just variety / interest

findings: WINTER WATCH, Rainline and Shoreless tie at 4/5 for both rated dimensions.
Basalt, original Ringfall and EQ-treated Ringfall tie at 3.5/5. No preference improvement demonstrated by this EQ treatment.
Spirewatch 3/5, with user note too fast really to be ambient. Perceived pace, not a measured BPM.
User says rain adds variety/interest on Rainline. Contribution remains confounded with different music until the same dry source is compared with/without rain.
Spirewatch spectral similarity did not predict preference. Prior starting-point recommendation is superseded by these listening results.
These are existing published recordings at matched levels, with only Ringfall EQ as a new treatment; no new ElevenLabs compositions.
